title: Conquest or catastrophe? How historians judge the conquest
goal: Read how historians disagree about the conquest and the Black Legend, and use *creer que* and *no creer que* to attribute opinions.

items: Use *creer que* and *no creer que* with the right mood to say what historians think.
Explain why some historians use the word conquest and others the word catastrophe.
Say what historians do not agree about.
Say what Bernardino de Sahagún did.
Say what Julián Juderías said about the Black Legend.
I can use *creer que* and *no creer que* with the right mood to say what historians think.

I can say what historians do not agree about.

I can say what Julián Juderías said about the Black Legend.
